points.title: 学徒时期
points.description: 桑德罗·波提切利出生于佛罗伦萨，原名亚历山德罗·迪·马里亚诺·菲利佩皮。他最初在金匠学徒马尔科·德尔·博尔戈尼奥的工作坊学习，随后进入画家菲利波·利比的工作室。这一时期，他接受了早期文艺复兴风格的训练，学习了透视法和色彩运用。利比的影响在波提切利早期作品中尤为明显，尤其是对细节的关注和优雅的人物表现。佛罗伦萨的艺术氛围和美第奇家族的赞助为他的艺术发展提供了理想环境。
points.descriptionEn: Sandro Botticelli was born in Florence, originally named Alessandro di Mariano Filipepi. He began his training as an apprentice in the workshop of goldsmith Marco del Buono, then moved to the studio of painter Filippo Lippi. During this period, he received training in early Renaissance style, learning perspective and color application. Lippi's influence is particularly evident in Botticelli's early works, especially in his attention to detail and elegant figure representation. Florence's artistic atmosphere and the patronage of the Medici family provided an ideal environment for his artistic development.

points.title: 独立工作室
points.description: 1465年左右，波提切利开设了自己的工作室。这一时期，他创作了《圣母玛利亚与圣子》等宗教题材作品，逐渐形成了自己独特的风格。他与安德烈亚·德尔·韦罗基奥工作室有合作，可能参与了韦罗基奥的《基督的洗礼》的创作，负责画背景中的天使。1470年，他获得了第一个独立委托作品《圣塞巴斯蒂安》，标志着他作为独立艺术家的确立。这一时期，他开始受到新柏拉图主义哲学的影响，这将对他的艺术创作产生深远影响。
points.descriptionEn: Around 1465, Botticelli established his own workshop. During this period, he created religious-themed works such as 'Madonna and Child' and gradually developed his distinctive style. He collaborated with Andrea del Verrocchio's workshop, possibly participating in Verrocchio's 'The Baptism of Christ', where he painted the angels in the background. In 1470, he received his first independent commission, 'Saint Sebastian', marking his establishment as an independent artist. During this time, he began to be influenced by Neoplatonic philosophy, which would have a profound impact on his artistic creations.

points.title: 美第奇赞助
points.description: 这一时期是波提切利艺术生涯的黄金时期。他受到洛伦佐·德·美第奇（'伟大的洛伦佐'）的赞助，成为美第奇家族圈子的核心艺术家。他为美第奇家族创作了多幅肖像画，包括《朱利亚诺·德·美第奇》和《洛伦佐·德·美第奇》。1478年，在帕齐阴谋后，他创作了《帕齐家族的圣母子》，反映了美第奇家族的政治立场。这一时期，他还创作了《维纳斯的诞生》和《春》等代表作，这些作品融合了古典神话与基督教元素，体现了新柏拉图主义美学思想。
points.descriptionEn: This period marked the golden age of Botticelli's artistic career. He was patronized by Lorenzo de' Medici ('the Magnificent') and became a central artist in the Medici circle. He created numerous portraits for the Medici family, including 'Giuliano de' Medici' and 'Lorenzo de' Medici'. After the Pazzi conspiracy in 1478, he painted 'The Madonna of the Pazzi', reflecting the political stance of the Medici family. During this time, he also created masterpieces such as 'The Birth of Venus' and 'Spring', which blend classical mythology with Christian elements, embodying Neoplatonic aesthetic ideas.

points.title: 西斯廷教堂
points.description: 1481-1482年，波提切利应教皇西克斯图斯四世之邀前往罗马，参与西斯廷教堂的壁画创作。他与多位佛罗伦萨艺术家共同完成了《摩西生平》和《基督生平》系列壁画。这一经历使他的艺术风格更加宏伟和庄重，同时也接触到了罗马的艺术传统。返回佛罗伦萨后，他继续为美第奇家族服务，创作了《三博士来朝》等作品。1490年代，他的风格开始变得更加复杂，融合了更多象征主义元素。
points.descriptionEn: In 1481-1482, Botticelli was invited to Rome by Pope Sixtus IV to participate in the fresco decoration of the Sistine Chapel. He worked with several Florentine artists to complete the series of frescoes on the 'Life of Moses' and 'Life of Christ'. This experience made his artistic style more grand and solemn, while also exposing him to Roman artistic traditions. After returning to Florence, he continued to serve the Medici family, creating works such as 'The Adoration of the Magi'. In the 1490s, his style began to become more complex, incorporating more symbolic elements.

points.title: 晚年与宗教影响
points.description: 洛伦佐·德·美第奇去世后，波提切利的艺术生涯受到重大影响。1494年，萨沃纳罗拉在佛罗伦萨崛起，波提切利受到其布道的影响，艺术风格变得更加虔诚和朴素。他烧毁了自己的一些早期作品，包括一些异教主题的画作。晚年，他主要创作宗教题材作品，如《神秘的诞生》等。1504年，他参与了达·芬奇的《安吉亚里之战》和米开朗基罗的《卡希纳之战》的评审委员会。1510年，波提切利在佛罗伦萨逝世，被安葬在圣母百花大教堂。
points.descriptionEn: After the death of Lorenzo de' Medici, Botticelli's artistic career suffered a significant impact. In 1494, the rise of Savonarola in Florence influenced Botticelli, whose artistic style became more pious and simple. He burned some of his early works, including paintings with pagan themes. In his later years, he mainly focused on religious subjects, such as 'The Mystical Nativity'. In 1504, he served on the committee to judge Leonardo da Vinci's 'Battle of Anghiari' and Michelangelo's 'Battle of Cascina'. Botticelli died in Florence in 1510 and was buried in the Florence Cathedral.

appraisal.zh: 波提切利通常被看作文艺复兴时期佛罗伦萨画派的代表，其线条优雅而富诗意，《维纳斯的诞生》与《春》融古典神话与基督教精神于一体，体现了人文主义精髓，后期风格转变也成为观察佛罗伦萨政治宗教变迁的窗口。另一种看法认为，他在透视与解剖上不及达·芬奇、米开朗基罗，技法偏于保守，后期受萨沃纳罗拉影响而失去活力，成就亦常被美第奇家族的政治影响所掩盖。
appraisal.en: Botticelli is generally regarded as a representative of the Florentine school of the Renaissance, elegant and poetic in line, whose Birth of Venus and Spring fuse classical myth with Christian spirit in the humanist vein, and whose later stylistic shift offers a window onto Florentine political and religious change. Another view holds that he lagged behind Leonardo and Michelangelo in perspective and anatomy, remained technically conservative, lost vitality under Savonarola's influence, and is often overshadowed by Medici political influence.

supporter.zh: 波提切利被视为文艺复兴时期最优雅的艺术家之一，他的作品展现了无与伦比的线条美感和诗意。他的代表作《维纳斯的诞生》和《春》完美融合了古典神话与基督教精神，体现了文艺复兴时期人文主义思想的精髓。波提切利对细节的精致处理和对人物情感的细腻表达，使他成为意大利文艺复兴黄金时期的重要代表，其艺术成就对后世产生了深远影响。
supporter.en: Botticelli is regarded as one of the most elegant artists of the Renaissance period, whose works demonstrate unparalleled linear beauty and poetic grace. His masterpieces 'The Birth of Venus' and 'Spring' perfectly blend classical mythology with Christian spirit, embodying the essence of humanistic thought during the Renaissance. Botticelli's exquisite attention to detail and nuanced expression of human emotions make him a significant representative of the golden age of Italian Renaissance, with his artistic achievements having a profound impact on later generations.

critic.zh: 批评者指出波提切利的艺术存在局限性，特别是在透视和解剖学方面不如达·芬奇和米开朗基罗等同时代艺术家。他的后期作品受到萨沃纳罗拉宗教改革的影响，失去了早期作品的创新性和活力。此外，波提切利在艺术技法上相对保守，未能完全掌握新兴的科学透视法，这使他的作品在三维空间表现上显得平面化。他的艺术成就也常被美第奇家族的政治影响所掩盖，缺乏独立的艺术立场。
critic.en: Critics point out that Botticelli's art had limitations, particularly in perspective and anatomy compared to his contemporaries like Leonardo da Vinci and Michelangelo. His later works, influenced by Savonarola's religious reforms, lost the innovation and vitality of his earlier pieces. Additionally, Botticelli was relatively conservative in artistic techniques, failing to fully master the emerging scientific perspective, which made his compositions appear somewhat flat in spatial representation. His artistic achievements are often overshadowed by the political influence of the Medici family, lacking an independent artistic stance.

objective.zh: 在历史学界和流行文化中，波提切利被定义为文艺复兴时期佛罗伦萨画派的代表人物，其作品体现了从哥特式到文艺复兴风格的过渡。他的《维纳斯的诞生》已成为西方艺术中最著名的图像之一，频繁出现在流行文化中，从时尚设计到广告宣传。波提切利的艺术生涯反映了佛罗伦萨政治和宗教变革对艺术的影响，他的风格转变被视为理解文艺复兴时期社会变迁的重要窗口。现代学者越来越重视他在艺术史上的独特贡献，特别是他对古典神话的重新诠释和对女性美的独特表现。
objective.en: In historical scholarship and popular culture, Botticelli is defined as a representative figure of the Florentine school of the Renaissance, whose works reflect the transition from Gothic to Renaissance styles. His 'The Birth of Venus' has become one of the most famous images in Western art, frequently appearing in popular culture from fashion design to advertising. Botticelli's career reflects the impact of Florentine political and religious changes on art, and his stylistic shifts are considered important windows for understanding social changes during the Renaissance. Modern scholars increasingly value his unique contributions to art history, particularly his reinterpretation of classical mythology and his distinctive representation of feminine beauty.

self.zh: 绘画是诗歌的视觉姐妹。
self.en: Painting is the visual sister of poetry.
